summary: Rolls-Royce had no card file; created src/data/model-cards/rolls-royce.json with 14 cards / 26 generations (Phantom VII/VIII, Phantom Coupé and Drophead, Ghost I/II, Wraith, Dawn, Cullinan, Spectre, Silver Seraph, Corniche I–V, Silver Spirit/Spur I–IV, Silver Shadow I/II, Camargue, Silver Cloud I–III) with Series II facelifts, engines, dimensions and 13 trims, all from fixed Wikipedia revisions. Proposed slug/year fixes for 17 models-auto entries, 7 removals (series duplicates, coachbuilt one-offs) and the missing Corniche; photos left null because the Commons API rate-limited this run.
